draft_metadata.filename_title: 深海真菌 P. polonicum CS-252 中的疣孢菌素衍生物
draft_metadata.classification_reason: 本研究为天然产物化学的结构鉴定与生物活性评价工作，不涉及生物合成途径解析、酶工程改造或细胞工厂生产，论文允许路径列表为空；其真实学科方向为海洋微生物次生代谢产物的分离与结构表征。
source_gaps: 未提供 Supporting Information PDF，故 Figure S5 (compound 1 的 HSQC) 等附件图无法直接核对；Figure S42 (compound 4 DP4+ 详细) 缺失，文中仅引用 99.91% 的概率结论。
化合物 5 因稳定性差且为不纯混合物，未获得 NOESY 数据，C-6 双键几何构型仅由 13C-NMR 的 γ-gauche 效应与 DP4+ 概率分析推断。
部分 ECD 谱图的纵坐标单位为 mdeg，作者提供 Δε 值，但曲线峰值的精确高度仅可定性读取，不能从图像估算精确数值。
正文 Section 3.4 标题误写为 'Fermentation, Extraction and Isolation'，但内容实际为 ECD 计算方法描述（构象搜索、B3LYP/6-31G(d) 优化、BH&HLYP/TZVP TDDFT、SCRF/PCM MeOH 溶剂校正），与 3.5 节 'ECD Calculations' 实质重叠；此为原版式瑕疵，保留原标题并注明以忠实于原文。

verified_claims.claim: 菌株来源与身份：从南海冷泉 1183 m 沉积物分离 Penicillium polonicum CS-252（ITS 100% 同 MZ301257.1，登录号 OK175489.1）
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF p.1 摘要；p.8 Section 3.2 Fungal Material
verified_claims.evidence: 'obtained from cold-seep sediments collected in the South China Sea at a depth of 1183 m'; 'ITS region sequence...the same (100%) as that of P. polonicum FNG3 (MZ301257.1)...OK175489.1'

verified_claims.claim: 分离鉴定了 6 个新型化合物 poloncosidins A–F (1–6) 与 1 个已知类似物 deoxyverrucosidin (7)；1–5 为 verrucosidin 家族首批含 2,5-二氢呋喃环的成员
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF p.1 摘要；p.2 Introduction；p.10 Conclusions
verified_claims.evidence: 'Six novel verrucosidin derivatives, namely, poloncosidins A–F (1–6), together with one known analogue (7)...Compounds 1–5 represent the first examples of verrucosidins with a 2,5-dihydrofuran ring which is uncommon among the known analogues.'

verified_claims.source_locator: PDF p.3–7 各化合物段落；Figure 4–10 图注
verified_claims.evidence: '(12S,15R)-isomer of compound 1...leading to the establishment of the absolute configuration of 1 as 12S, 15R'; '4a-(2R,10S,13R)] was the equivalent structure with a probability of 99.91%'; '5b-(6Z,12S,15R)] matched well...probability = 100%'; 'isomer (12S,13S,14R,15R)-6 matched well'

'The statistical analysis indicated that the isomer [4a-(2R,10S,13R)] was the equivalent structure with a probability of 99.91%'; 'The 13C-NMR data calculated for the isomer [5b-(6Z,12S,15R)] matched well with the experimental data of 5 (probability = 100%)'

verified_claims.claim: MIC 数据（Table 3）：化合物 4 对 E. coli 4.0、K. pneumoniae 32、MRSA 16、P. aeruginosa 16、V. alginolyticus 8.0、V. parahemolyticus 16 µg/mL；化合物 1 对 P. aeruginosa/V. alginolyticus/V. parahemolyticus 分别为 8.0/8.0/4.0 µg/mL；化合物 7 对 P. aeruginosa 和 V. parahemolyticus 均为 8.0 µg/mL；化合物 4 和 6 总体 MIC 范围 4–32 µg/mL
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF p.8 Table 3；p.7 Results and Discussion 末尾段落
verified_claims.evidence: Table 3 第 4 列 '4.0/32/16/16/8.0/16'；第 6 列 '32/16/–/16/8.0/16'；'compound 1...P. aeruginosa QDIO-4, V. alginolyticus QDIO-5, and V. parahemolyticus QDIO-8 with MICs 8.0, 8.0, and 4.0 µg/mL'；'compounds 4 and 6 displayed inhibitory activity...MIC values ranging from 4 to 32 µg/mL'

verified_claims.claim: 构效关系：缺失 α-吡喃酮 (4、6) 抗菌谱更广；C-2 甲基化与 2,5-二氢呋喃环增强活性 (1 vs 2、7)；三取代双键缺失 (3) 不利
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF p.8 抗菌活性段落；p.10 Conclusions
verified_claims.evidence: 'without the formation of the α-pyrone moiety exhibited a broad spectrum of antimicrobial activity... (4 and 6 vs. 1–3, and 7)'; 'the methylation at C-2 and the 2,5-dihydrofuran ring in these compounds enhanced their activities (1 vs. 2 and 7)'; 'the absence of a trisubstituted double bond in the polyene linker (compound 3) likely had an adverse effect'
